=== NEW PATTERN A3 CARD CONTENTS ===
• Keyword-anchor line covering 'running cumulative percent of total','running cumulative percent of month total','cumulative percent of grand total','percent collected by end of day','Pareto cumulative percent','Pareto chart','80/20 rule','top N products make up 80 percent','what percent reached by day N / product N','cumulative_pct','cum_pct_of_total','running share of grand total'.
• THE ONE FACT: single leading `100.0 *` does TWO jobs (percent-conversion + decimal-division-forcing); NEVER also append `* 100`.
• Leading canonical (CTE form, preferred): `WITH daily AS (SUM(amount) GROUP BY order_date), SELECT ... ROUND(100.0 * SUM(daily_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) / SUM(daily_revenue) OVER (), 1) AS cumulative_pct_of_total` — bounded window (May 2026), pre-aggregate-then-window recipe (mirrors r07:1829 iter667 BROADEN), single 100.0*, no trailing *100.
• Expected-output table showing the running cumulative percent rising MONOTONICALLY to EXACTLY 100.0 on the last row (e.g. 10.0 → 15.0 → 40.0 → ... → 100.0).
• Pareto variant: `ORDER BY product_revenue DESC` so the running cumulative percent climbs steeply as you walk the ranked products (Top N = 80%); shows how to find the smallest N that crosses 80%.
• Inline alternative: `SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER (ORDER BY order_date ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)` + `SUM(SUM(amount)) OVER ()` with GROUP BY order_date in the same SELECT — labelled as Trino 467 valid (window-over-GROUP-BY-aggregate, same construct as Pattern A2 at r07:1894 `SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (...)`), with a 'CTE form is clearer, prefer it unless golfing' note.
• DO-NOT-WRITE table (3 rows): (a) `100.0 * x / y * 100` — DOUBLE-multiply (the exact iter688 Q3 fab; result = 100x too large; final row = 10000.0 not 100.0); (b) `x / y * 100` without a decimal cast — integer division truncates to 0 BEFORE the *100 (every row shows 0); (c) `SUM(x) OVER (ORDER BY d ROWS ...)` alone, missing the SUM(x) OVER () denominator — gives a running ABSOLUTE total in dollars, NOT a percent.
• Cross-references: Pattern A r07:1700+ (running-SUM numerator), Pattern A2 r07:1868+ (window-over-aggregate construct the inline form uses), share-of-grand-total r07:1234+ (the single-100.0 denominator primitive), r23 §3 integer-division trap, r28 GROUPING SETS/ROLLUP/CUBE for the grand-total-row alternative shape.

=== DOCS-TRUTH VERIFIED (WebFetch before writing) ===
• trino.io/docs/467/functions/window.html — 'All Aggregate functions can be used as window functions by adding the OVER clause' — already canonicalized in r07:1234 (share-of-grand-total) + r07:1872 (Pattern A2 window-over-aggregate). The construct `SUM(SUM(x)) OVER (...)` with GROUP BY is the same Pattern A2 already uses (`SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (...)` at r07:1894). Pattern A2 is itself doc-cited and HELD.
• Single `100.0 *` semantics: `100.0 *` is a DECIMAL literal multiplier that forces decimal division (avoiding the integer/integer=0 truncation) AND converts the 0..1 ratio to a 0..100 percent. Applying both `100.0 *` (leading) AND `* 100` (trailing) multiplies by 10000 total — verified arithmetically and matches the iter688 Q3 symptom (final row = 10000.0 instead of 100.0).
• Integer-division trap — verified at r23 §3 already (cross-referenced from the new card).
• Trino 467 dialect — no QUALIFY, no PERCENTILE_CONT, no PIVOT, no MEDIAN; ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW is the standard ANSI frame; ROUND(x, n) with positive n for decimal places; CTE + window-in-outer-SELECT is the preferred composition shape per Pattern A iter667-BROADEN at r07:1829-1849.
